metadata.method: Serial fresh headless processes. Two rounds, before/after then after/before; 1 discarded warmup and 7 measured samples per process. 100k-line ANSI received two additional reversed-order rounds (28 measured samples per version). Diagnostics use 5 measured samples per process and are excluded from regression summary.
limitations: Headless macOS arm64 measurements, not GUI frame or key-to-screen latency.
No controlled CPU frequency or exclusive host scheduling. ANSI throughput varied considerably between process runs.
Retained Lua memory is post-GC Lua heap delta, not peak memory or process RSS.
Microbench typing uses buffer API edits; output writes use 128-line batches and omit subprocess startup and parsing.
Diagnostic variants monkeypatch APIs only in temporary benchmark processes; repository implementation is unchanged.
metadata.harness_correction: The nonexistent incremental/chunk_128 selector was replaced by the existing chunk_100 workload. The four invalid selector attempts are preserved separately; no runtime assertion failures were excluded.

out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env=dict(os.environ, PLENARY_PATH='/Users/taolintian/.local/share/nvim/lazy/plenary.nvim',BALEIA_PATH='/private/tmp/compile-mode-dev/baleia.nvim',BENCH_SAMPLES='7',NVIM_LOG_FILE=str(out/'nvim.log'), XDG_STATE_HOME=str(out/'state'))
cases=[('benchmark',f'end_to_end/{kind}/{size}') for size in (10000,100000) for kind in ('plain','errors','ansi')]
cases += [('benchmark',x+'/10000') for x in ('buffer/write','ansi/filter','ansi/render','scan/plain','scan/errors','incremental/chunk_1','incremental/chunk_128')]
cases += [('long_lines',f'pipeline/{size}') for size in (1000,4000)]
results=[]
for repeat in (1,2):
 for suite,case in cases:
  for label,path in ([('before',before),('after',root)] if repeat==1 else [('after',root),('before',before)]):
   dest=out/f'{repeat}-{label}-{suite}-{case.replace("/","_")}.json'
   runenv=dict(env,COMPILE_MODE_RESULT=str(dest),BENCH_SIZES=case.split('/')[-1])
   cmd=['nvim','--headless','--clean','-u','scripts/minimal_init.lua','-l',f'scripts/{suite}.lua',case]
   t=time.monotonic()
   proc=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=path,env=runenv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
   result=json.loads(dest.read_text()) if dest.exists() else {'passed':False,'error':proc.stdout+proc.stderr}
   results.append(dict(round=repeat,version=label,suite=suite,case=case,result=result))
   (out/'raw.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
   print(repeat,label,case,round(result.get('median_ms',-1),3), 'ms',result.get('error',''),flush=True)

local s = require('scripts.support')
local input_ok, input = pcall(require, 'compile-mode.input')
local buffer = require('compile-mode.buffer')
local kind, history_count = arg[1], tonumber(arg[2])
local samples = tonumber(vim.env.BENCH_SAMPLES) or 7
s.setup()
local function prepare()
 local lines = {}
 for i=1,history_count do lines[i] = ('build step %d complete'):format(i) end
 local b = s.buffer(lines)
 vim.api.nvim_set_current_buf(b)
 if input_ok then input.attach(b, function() return true end) end
 return {buf=b}
end
local function enter(b)
 input.enter(b)
 vim.api.nvim_feedkeys('', 'nx', false)
 vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(b,input.count(b),-1,false,{'draft remains intact'})
end
local result
if kind == 'open' then
 assert(input_ok)
 result=s.measure('open input',1,prepare,function(ctx) enter(ctx.buf) end,function(ctx)
  assert(input.has_draft(ctx.buf))
 end,samples)
elseif kind == 'typing' then
 assert(input_ok)
 result=s.measure('100 draft edits',100,function()
  local ctx=prepare(); enter(ctx.buf);return ctx
 end,function(ctx)
  for i=1,100 do
   vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(ctx.buf,input.count(ctx.buf),-1,false,{string.rep('x',i)})
  end
 end,function(ctx)
  assert(vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(ctx.buf,input.count(ctx.buf),-1,false)[1]==string.rep('x',100))
 end,samples)
else
 local record_count = kind == 'records' and 1000 or 0
 result=s.measure('append 10000 output lines in 128-line batches',10000,function()
  local ctx=prepare()
  if kind ~= 'closed' then
   assert(input_ok);enter(ctx.buf)
   for _=1,record_count do input.submit(ctx.buf) end
   vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(ctx.buf,input.count(ctx.buf),-1,false,{'draft remains intact'})
  end
  return ctx
 end,function(ctx)
  for first=1,10000,128 do
   local data={}
   for i=first,math.min(10000,first+127) do data[#data+1]='new output '..i end
   buffer.set_lines(ctx.buf,-1,-1,data,false)
  end
  s.drain()
 end,function(ctx)
  local expected=history_count+10000+record_count+(kind=='closed' and 0 or 1)
  assert(vim.api.nvim_buf_line_count(ctx.buf)==expected)
  if kind~='closed' then
   assert(vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(ctx.buf,input.count(ctx.buf),-1,false)[1]=='draft remains intact')
  end
 end,samples)
end
result.name=kind..'/'..history_count
result.history_lines=history_count
result.passed=true
s.finish(result)
